## How it will work

::: {.learning-rhythm}
::: {.rhythm-part}
### Refresh and check

::: {.time-label}
15–20 minutes
:::

A short lesson with clear explanations, worked examples and questions to try. Reveal the answers and feedback when you are ready.
:::

::: {.rhythm-part}
### Put it into practice

::: {.time-label}
About 40 minutes
:::

Follow up with selected Year 10 textbook questions to consolidate your understanding. Exercise references will accompany each lesson.
:::
:::

::: {.closing-note}
You do not need to remember everything already. The program is designed to help you revisit ideas, work through mistakes and rebuild fluency at your own pace.
:::
